It may certainly be hard to know yourself.{wait}{clear}But if you try to know, you should understand little by little.{wait}{clear}Even if you lose your way and make mistakes... I think that's what living is.{wait}{clear}

Hmph, then maybe it can't be helped that someone like me is like this.{wait}{clear}
Do you feel a little better now, Rocus?{wait}{clear}
Hmph! Who knows...{wait}{clear}Enough of this talk. Let's drink and talk about stupider things.{wait}{clear}
